title: 最后一卷
logline: 师父死后，学徒在暗房里冲洗他留下的最后一卷胶片，里面全是陌生人的脸。
poster_frame: 他坐在一地的陌生人照片中间，红光只照亮半张脸。

style.look: 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, fine grain, halation blooming on highlights
style.palette: muted cyan shadows against red safelight

characters.name: 学徒
characters.anchor: an 18-year-old apprentice, buzz-cut hair, faded navy canvas apron over a grey tee, dark freckles across the nose, dust on his knuckles

locations.name: 暗房
locations.anchor: a cramped 1980s photo studio darkroom, stained enamel developing trays, strings of drying prints overhead, one red safelight above the door

shots.beat: 他把最后一卷胶片举到红光下，像怕它碎掉
shots.subject: {{CHAR_A}}
action: holds a small brass film canister up to the red safelight with both hands, as if it might break
shots.atmosphere: faint chemical haze in the air
shots.lighting: hard red key from screen-left rims his cheekbone and one eye, everything else in soft shadow, a bead of sweat catching the light at his temple
shots.camera: performs a very slow 8% push-in over the full 6 seconds
shots.lens: 50mm at T2, shallow depth so the doorway melts into red bokeh
sound: a single drip into a tray
shots.speaker: CHAR_A

shots.subject: two thumbs prying the brass lid off a film canister, the metal edge nicked and green with age, dust falling from the seam
action: the lid gives with a dry click
shots.lighting: hard red safelight from screen-left, dark shadows in the knuckle creases, the rest of the frame near black
shots.camera: static locked-off on a tripod, no camera movement
shots.lens: 100mm macro at T4, razor-thin depth of field

shots.beat: 他举起一张照片，上面是陌生人的脸
shots.subject: {{CHAR_A}}
action: lifts one wet print by its corner from a wire
holds it still while the paper trembles
shots.lighting: red safelight above and behind him, his face a half-lit silhouette, the print catching the light
shots.camera: trucks right one slow step, ending with the print centered and the boy at the edge of frame

shots.beat: 他坐在一地陌生人的脸中间
shots.subject: {{CHAR_A}}
action: sits on an upturned crate in the middle of the floor, head down, apron bunched at his waist
shots.atmosphere: a dozen wet prints of strangers spread around his feet
shots.lighting: red light from screen-left, the corners of the room falling to black
shots.camera: dollies back slowly through the doorway, ending with the red rectangle of the door framing him
shots.lens: 35mm at T2.8, deep enough that the trays read
